group_protocol.scope: Controlled filename replay groups only; not verified physical temporal sequences

policy.baseline: Existing V0 quality outputs only; no V0 replay or modification
policy.algorithm_independence: Host comparison does not execute or populate candidate outputs. Source/build/board staging audit must separately prove new V2 did not consume V0 result files.
policy.strict_maps: All signed int32 types and every float32 min/max/avg bit, including unknown cells, signed zeros, NaN payloads and sentinels; no mask, class merge, tolerance, resize or registration
policy.png: Canonical host PNG independently rendered from each side raw types with common injective observed palette and flipud; not native SDK renderer PNG. Compare decoded RGB and PNG bytes.
policy.detector: Raw-model ordered numeric list before map keep gate; V0 raw_detections, candidate raw_detections if exported else detections. Business/map-input list compared separately only with explicit source-stage declaration.
policy.uv: Camera XYZ projected independently using that record K and rounded to source integer pixels; derived UV, not independently captured sampler UV
policy.calibration: Actual six serialized values normalized by units/field aliases; numeric and float64-bit checks, no forcing V0 transform onto candidate
